title: Error when I try to start Dexcom G6
symptom: User cannot start Dexcom G6 sensor; gets an error when trying to start it. Tried stopping sensor, restarting phone, starting with code 0000, waiting 15 minutes, then starting with real code, but problem reappears after a few seconds.
evidence_quote: I have the Dexcom G6 but I can't start it because I get an error when I try to start it
